names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 28 octombrie, «Sfântul Mucenic Terentie cu cei 7 fii ai săi».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 28 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιοι Τερέντιος και Νεονίλλη οι σύζυγοι και τα παιδιά τους…», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the title on this one's name link behind the household's line for 28 октября ст. ст., «Терентий Сирийский, мч.», with the rank word left off. The line itself gives the name in the genitive and without the province.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 28. октобар ст. ст., „Св. муч. Теренције.“ — «Св.» is "saint" and not a rank and «муч.» is the martyr grade this corpus keeps in `types`, so both come off and the bare personal name is the whole of the form. The heading gives no by-name and no company: «Из Сирије», which the folder’s Russian form carries as a toponymic, is the body’s first sentence, and the wife and seven children who distinguish him are the body’s second. `foldchk.py` finds this exact string on `terentius-of-africa`, who is kept by this same book on the Julian 10 April and by the Russian calendar on this very day — so the form joins a fold of two, keyed in `READ_FOLDS` in the same commit, and the fold is the sharpest kind: the two men the day itself could have confused.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 октября ст. ст. — «Мчч. Терентия и Неониллы и чад их: Сарвила , Фота , Феодула , Иеракса , Нита , Вила , Евникии (ок. 249-250).»
source.note: The icon the page sets before this line is «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — a service with no typikon mark — so no rank is recorded.

attestations.note: The Russian calendar keeps the whole household on this day in one line and gives each of the nine a name link of its own; this is the father. The link's title is «Терентий Сирийский, мч.», and the stored form is that title with the rank word left off — it adds the province the Romanian and Greek pages do not name. The line itself declines the name, so the nominative is the link's. The year «(ок. 249-250)» is the line's and is new to this folder, which had no date at all.

source.text: doxologia.ro, 28 octombrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Terentie cu cei 7 fii ai săi»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Τερέντιος και Νεονίλλη οι σύζυγοι και τα παιδιά τους Σάρβηλος, Νίτας, Ιέραξ, Θεόδουλος, Φώτιος, Βήλη και Ευνίκη»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the entry enumerates the same household the corpus already keeps as nine folders: the two spouses and the seven children, each with his own heading on the page. saint.gr gives the company no year, so no `dates` object is proposed. It prints one apolytikion, Ἦχος γ’ Θείας πίστεως, which names Terence, Neonilla and «ἡ τῶν Παίδων ὑμῶν ἑπτὰς ἔνθεος» and no other saint, and that is taken into all nine folders; it also prints a Κάθισμα, which is neither a troparion nor a kontakion and is not drafted. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 10.11.2025 (28. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Теренције.“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, three sentences long, one person in the heading. «муч.» is the `martyr` this folder already holds, so `types` is untouched. THE IDENTIFICATION IS THE HARDEST ON THIS DAY AND THE NAME AND THE DAY BOTH POINT THE WRONG WAY. The corpus keeps two Terences. `terentius-of-africa` is one of a company of men martyred at Carthage in 250 — and he stands on the RUSSIAN 28 OCTOBER, the very day of this entry, AND he already holds the Serbian form «Теренције» off this same book’s Julian 10 April. So a match on the name, or on the name and the day together, lands on him. WHAT SETTLES IT IS THE HOUSEHOLD: this entry says «Из Сирије» and «Пострадао за веру Христову заједно са женом и седморо деце своје» — from Syria, suffered together with his wife and his seven children. That is `terence-husband-of-neonilla`, whose own Russian stored form is «Терентий Сирийский», Terence the Syrian, and whose eight `related` rows are Neonilla and the seven sons. THE WIFE AND THE SEVEN CHILDREN GET NOTHING, AND THAT IS SECTION 5. The heading enumerates one person; the household is narrated and not one of its nine members is named. All eight exist as folders — `neonilla-wife-of-terence` and the seven — and every one of them already relates this folder both ways, so nothing is owed and nothing was added. A company this book declines to name is a company this book gives no rows for. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND THE ENTRY GIVES NO YEAR. The folder holds `death` 249 to 250 off the Russian calendar’s «(ок. 249-250)», recorded there as the household’s interval and not this man’s alone. This entry gives no year, no emperor and no consul, so there is nothing to narrow it with. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS. Almost nothing, and the almost is worth the line: AFTER MANY TORMENTS, DURING WHICH THE POWER OF GOD WAS MANIFESTED, ALL OF THEM WERE BEHEADED WITH THE SWORD. The manifestation of God’s power under torture is this book’s own; the common death by the sword agrees with what the folder had. NO NEW `related`, NO `office`, NO `locations` — Syria is named and is not a coordinate. THE FORM FOLDS AND THE FOLD IS KEYED: «Теренције» is already held by `terentius-of-africa`, so this takes the key from one holder to two, and the two folders it joins are precisely the two this day could have confused. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day’s verse is Bishop Nikolai’s own and is about Arsenius.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Terentie, al Sfintei Neonila și al celor împreună cu dânșii, Glasul 4

english.text: Your martyrs, O Lord, in their contests received from you, our God, the crowns of incorruption; for possessing your strength they overthrew their torturers and broke the feeble daring of the demons. By their prayers save our souls, O Christ God.

hymns.text: Νόμω φύσεως, συνδεδεμένοι, κράτος πίστεως, ἐνδεδυμένοι, μαρτυρίου τὴν ὁδὸν διηνύσατε, σὺν Νεονίλλη θεόφρον Τερέντιε, καὶ ἡ τῶν Παίδων ὑμῶν ἑπτὰς ἔνθεος. Καὶ νῦν ἄφεσιν, αἰτήσασθε παμμακάριστοι, τοὶς μέλπουσιν ὑμῶν τὴν θείαν ἄθλησιν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιοι Τερέντιος και Νεονίλλη οι σύζυγοι και τα παιδιά τους Σάρβηλος, Νίτας, Ιέραξ, Θεόδουλος, Φώτιος, Βήλη και Ευνίκη». It names Terence and Neonilla and their godly seven children, and no other saint.

english.text: Bound together by the law of nature, and clothed with the strength of faith, you finished the road of martyrdom, Terence of godly mind, with Neonilla and the godly seven of your children. And now, all-blessed ones, ask forgiveness for those who sing of your divine contest.

hymns.text: Мученицы Твои, Господи,/ во страданиих своих венцы прияша нетленныя от Тебе, Бога нашего:/ имуще бо крепость Твою,/ мучителей низложиша,/ сокрушиша и демонов немощныя дерзости,/ тех молитвами// спаси души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь мучеников Терентия и Неонилы и чад их»
source.note: The common of martyrs, printed under the household's name, which makes it theirs (BRIEF.md §4); it names none of them.

english.text: Your martyrs, O Lord, in their sufferings received incorruptible crowns from you, our God; for having your strength they cast down the tormentors and broke the feeble daring of the demons. By their prayers save our souls.

hymns.text: Мученическая честная память прииде днесь,/ веселящи всяческая,/ Терентия премудраго и подружии его,/ тепле убо стецемся,/ да приимем исцеление,/ сии бо благодать приемше от Духа Святаго// исцеляти недуги и болезни душ наших.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак мучеников Терентия и Неонилы и чад их»
source.note: The household's own kontakion, and the only hymn on the day that names any of them: «Терентия премудраго и подружии его».

english.text: The honoured memory of the martyrs has come today, gladdening all things — of Terence the most wise and of his consort. Let us run to them with warmth, that we may receive healing; for they have received grace from the Holy Spirit to heal the infirmities and the sicknesses of our souls.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 28 октября ст. ст. closes the household with «(ок. 249-250)» — about 249 to 250. The Romanian and Greek pages this folder was written from give no year at all, so the interval is the Russian calendar's alone and is the household's and not this one person's.
